These are administrative-source assessments, not adjudicated findings; no material, supplier, account, payment, recipient, counterparty, or transaction selector is retained

The administrative action lists YU, Pu Ung, the Korean form 유부웅, the alternate romanization YU, Bu Ung, Shenyang, China, the NPWMD program, and the linked-to relationship with Tanchon Commercial Bank.
